question: What poetic attainment results from oblation with ghee-anointed mālatī flowers?
premises: Oblations are made with mālatī flowers anointed with ghee.
The oblation produces a specific result.
The result is swift poetic ability.
inference: From oblation with ghee-anointed mālatī flowers, one becomes a swift poet.
plain_english: From oblation with mālatī flowers anointed with ghee, one becomes a swift poet.
